meta.prompt: Design a compact card for a product team deciding the next demo. The choices are Search (4 votes), Offline mode (7), and Exports (5). Give me a voting control. Once I vote, replace it with results showing the updated shares and total and identify what I chose. Mention ‘One vote per teammate’.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Next demo" "Vote on the feature to show" icon:"how_to_vote" status:"Open"
  if !voted
    OptionList =choice options:["Search","Offline mode","Exports"] -> voted=true
    Paragraph "One vote per teammate."
  if voted
    PollResults options:["Search","Offline mode","Exports"] votes:[4+(choice=="Search"?1:0),7+(choice=="Offline mode"?1:0),5+(choice=="Exports"?1:0)] choice:=choice note:"One vote per teammate"

state choice=""
state voted=false
